Bid Summary.value: The Delano Union School District (bid number 2025-003) seeks to purchase Dell Chrome 3120 Chromebooks and HP Fortis 11 inch G10 Chromebooks with specifications listed in the product specification. Proposals must be received before 1:00 PM on September 6, 2024, submitted in a sealed envelope marked with the RFP number 2025-003 and returned to Delano Union School District, Business Services, 1405 12th Avenue, Delano, California, 93215. The contract term is twelve (12) months, with a 10 % bid security required in cash, a certified cashier’s check, or a bid bond, and delivery is expected by October 31, 2024. Warranty, installation, and payment terms are not specified in the bid, and no additional documentation or contract type is listed. Eligible bidders should note the absence of payment terms, installation details, and additional documentation requirements.
